definition: 土王用事 of a 四立 L = the 18 civil days [date(L) − 18, date(L) − 1]; date(L) itself excluded
derivation: 卷一 「土於四立之前各旺一十八日」: 18 days before each 四立 (rule)
推步捷例 「自四立節前一辰，逆數至十八日」: counting starts at 「四立節前一辰」
卷六 「四絶者四立前一辰也…故先一日為絶也」: 「前一辰」 = the civil day before 四立 (協紀-internal gloss)
推步 「寄旺四時共日七十二日」 and 卷一 「合之亦為七十二日」 require 4 × 18 = 72, ruling out the exclusive reading of 「逆數至十八日」 ([立−19, 立−1], 19 days): the entry day is counted
⇒ day 1 = date(L) − 1, day 18 = date(L) − 18; the 立 day starts the next element (卷一 各旺七十二日)
grade: B (rule derivation from 協紀 卷一 + 卷六 gloss, corroborated by 推步捷例); not A (no dated 時憲書 witness)

astronomy.input: 立春 / 立夏 / 立秋 / 立冬 instants (term index 21 / 3 / 9 / 15), true terms (定氣)
astronomy.authority: golden-v4/astronomy/solar-terms-jpl-de440s-clock-v1.json (JPL DE440s, clock-v1), the project astronomy authority already behind Month Jian; no second engine

conventions.定氣 vs 恆氣: 定氣 (Qing 時憲 basis, project-wide); 恆氣 is Ming 大統, not adopted
conventions.timezone: UTC+7 project convention; UTC+8 alternative flips 0 of the 502 five-context occurrences (66 window days differ overall). Only the soil calendar was varied: Month Jian and the day pillar rest on the same project-wide UTC+7 convention, which is outside G1-SOIL and not reopened
conventions.instant 2-hour reading of 前一辰: rejected by 卷六 gloss; would flip 2 occurrences (1939-01-17, 2042-01-16)
